name: SQL Picker - Open Card
purpose: Opens the SQL picker card: clears the table and field selection globals and opens the picker window; with a file name in the parameter it goes straight to listing that file's tables, otherwise it lists the open files first. Effect owner it would have: client-ui (developer tool).
calls:
karbon_Generator.fmp12/scripts/377 "Set VL_File" (step 11; Perform Script)
karbon_Generator.fmp12/scripts/395 "SQL Picker - Handle Click" (step 18; Perform Script)
open_question: Part of the Generator developer tool. The two branches both open the same layout.

name: SQL Picker - Handle Click
purpose: SQL picker click router: depending on the clicked list (Table, Field, FieldValue, ReturnField) copies the selection to the schema globals and refreshes the next list through the Set VL scripts. Effect owner it would have: client-ui (developer tool).
reads:
VIRTUALLIST::TableFileName#12 (step 16)
VIRTUALLIST::TableName#5 (step 17)
VIRTUALLIST::TableOccurenceName#11 (step 18)
VIRTUALLIST::FieldName#6 (step 25)
VIRTUALLIST::FieldValue#13 (step 32)
GLOBALS::Schema_File#21, GLOBALS::Schema_Table#22, GLOBALS::Schema_Field#24 (step 27)
writes:
GLOBALS::Schema_File#21 (Set Field step 16, global)
GLOBALS::Schema_Table#22 (Set Field step 17, global)
GLOBALS::Schema_TableOccurence#23 (Set Field step 18, global)
GLOBALS::Schema_Field#24 (Set Field step 25, global)
GLOBALS::Schema_FieldValue#25 (Set Field step 32, global)
calls:
karbon_Generator.fmp12/scripts/378 "Set VL_Table" (step 11; Perform Script)
karbon_Generator.fmp12/scripts/379 "Set VL_Field" (step 20; Perform Script)
karbon_Generator.fmp12/scripts/380 "Set VL_FieldValue" (step 27; Perform Script)
open_question: Part of the Generator developer tool.

name: SQL Picker - Save Card
purpose: SQL picker save: stores the selected field name as the return field and closes the picker card. Effect owner it would have: client-ui (developer tool).
open_question: Part of the Generator developer tool.
